verdict.rationale: Convex is explicitly a non-SQL, function-based reactive database ('no need to write any SQL... use JavaScript') accessed via its own client libraries, CLI, and HTTP API, not via a standard connection string usable by generic ORMs like Prisma or Drizzle. Self-hosting docs mention pairing with Postgres/Neon only as underlying infra, not as an ORM-compatible interface to Convex data itself.
